subject: [DB] Database migrations for the first release (468 tables, 32 schemas)

subject: [DevOps] Generate the typed API clients from contracts/ for the frontend workspace
description: Generate the typed API clients from contracts/ for the frontend workspace. In **ticvai-frontend** `packages/api-client`: generated from the package's `contracts/`, re-generated by one command and checked in CI on GitHub Actions (audit R057). Done when: every in-release operation has a typed call, the build fails if the contracts change without a re-generate, and screen tickets stop stubbing calls.

subject: [DevOps] PostgreSQL (tenant and control databases) and a forward-only migration runner that applies the MIG epic in order
description: PostgreSQL (tenant and control databases) and a forward-only migration runner that applies the MIG epic in order. In **ticvai-backend**: `SqlMigrationRunner` (in the starter) applies `db/tenant` and `db/control` - the package's derived DDL - in file order and records each file with its checksum in `platform.schema_version`. The databases run on Azure in the UAE region, connection strings from the cell's Key Vault (audit R057). Done when: both databases exist in dev, the runner applies every MIG file to an empty database, and a second run applies nothing.

subject: [DevOps] Logging and monitoring basics
description: Logging and monitoring basics. In **ticvai-backend** and **ticvai-infra**: structured logs and traces (OpenTelemetry, already referenced by the starter) shipped from dev and staging in the Azure UAE region (audit R057). Done when: a request can be followed from the API log to its trace, and an error raises an alert someone receives.

subject: [AI] AI gateway, governance decision point and usage metering
description: AI gateway, governance decision point and usage metering. One gateway every AI call goes through: provider (managed Azure by default; BYOK where TICVAI enables it), policy check (evaluateAiGovernance), usage and spend (getAiUsage), and the decision record for every answer. About 10 engineer-days.

subject: [BE] Hosts for the deployables on .NET 10: commerce, access, operations and workers, each composing its modules
description: Hosts for the deployables on .NET 10: commerce, access, operations and workers, each composing its modules. In ticvai-backend, on .NET 10 LTS (decided 30 September; ADR-0055). Four .NET hosts in one solution: commerce (Identity, Tenancy, Catalogue, Order, Ledger, Wallet), access (Access), operations (F&B, Retail, Inventory, VenueOps, Marketing, WhiteLabel, Reporting, Platform, CrossRegion) and workers (the outbox relay, every module's event consumers, scheduled jobs), each composing its modules through IModule. ticvai-ai stays the Python service. Done when: each host starts locally with its modules registered and a health endpoint, CI builds one image per host, and moving a module to another host is a change of one registration.

subject: [BE] Qdrant cluster in dev and staging: 3 nodes, TLS, snapshots, monitoring
description: Qdrant cluster in dev and staging: 3 nodes, TLS, snapshots, monitoring. In ticvai-infra (Terraform): a self-hosted 3-node Qdrant cluster in Azure UAE North for dev and staging (ADR-0049), pinned to 1.16 or later, with TLS, JWT RBAC on and the signing key in the cell's Key Vault, snapshot storage in the UAE, and monitoring and alerts on node health, disk and latency. Check Qdrant Hybrid Cloud on our own AKS as an alternative before building. Done when: the cluster survives the loss of one node, a snapshot of a test collection restores into a fresh cluster, and a request without a valid token is refused.

subject: [DB] Migration baseline: schemas, extensions, migration register, RLS helper functions and the monthly partition helpers (ADR-0056)
description: From backend/tenant/000-schemas.sql, 001-extensions.sql, 002-migration-register.sql, the helper functions at the top of 920-row-level-security.sql and 930-partitioning.sql; the control database's own 000-002. Everything else in the MIG epic runs after this.

subject: [AI] The baseline-then-learn layer: estimator interface, maturity stages, venue profile, starting patterns
description: The baseline-then-learn layer: estimator interface, maturity stages, venue profile, starting patterns. One interface per AI question with three answers behind it (starting pattern, statistical on the tenant's data, trained model); the stage and 'based on' label on every answer; the venue profile entered at onboarding; starting patterns per venue type with the UAE calendar and weather; no other tenant's data. About 15 engineer-days; the rest of the layer continues in Block B.

subject: [AI] Evaluation harness and the promotion alert
description: Evaluation harness and the promotion alert. Offline evaluation of every AI answer type against a fixture, the backtest runner the learned producers will use, and the promotion-ready alert to the admin (AI-D16). About 5 engineer-days.

subject: [AI] Help me choose: suggested question sets from the product catalogue
